arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Beeson argued the law violates the First Amendment.
She claimed the statute suppresses protected speech between adults.
She stated the government has less restrictive tools available.
General Olson argued the law addresses a compelling problem. He described online pornography as causing substantial damage to children.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on the constitutionality of the Child Online Protection Act. The ACLU contends the statute suppresses protected speech. The government asserts the law addresses a compelling harm to minors.
